{{Top|leg}}
An '''aerospace transport''' was a small, fast, and durable cargo vessel designed for low [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] travel. They were simpler than [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttlecraft]], and could devote more space to cargo as they had no need of [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems or large drive systems, placing them between [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and true [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
